description: This file contains a unit test for the React application 'App', specifically testing the accessibility attributes of skill progressbars within the app. It mocks IntersectionObserver for testing environment compatibility, renders the app component, and verifies ARIA attributes such as 'aria-valuenow', 'aria-valuemin', 'aria-valuemax', 'aria-labelledby', and 'aria-describedby' on progressbar elements.

methods.name: beforeAll
methods.description: Mocks the IntersectionObserver API if not supported by the environment to ensure smooth testing of visibility-related functionalities.

methods.name: test('Skills progressbars expose correct ARIA attributes')
methods.description: Main test case that renders the App component, locates the skills section, and verifies ARIA roles and attributes on progressbar elements for accessibility compliance.
